claim: One authorized, capped paid call settled on Celo mainnet and verified independently on chain.

approval.payloadSent: three boolean recorded_browser_check observations with step refs, plus the fixed prompt

onChain.verifiedBy: direct eth_getTransactionReceipt against https://forno.celo.org, independent of the provider receipt
onChain.note: The sender is the facilitator, not the payer: USDC on Celo implements EIP-3009, so the payer signs transferWithAuthorization off chain and the facilitator submits it and pays the gas. This is the sponsored-gas architecture the event asks entrants to describe.

reconciliation.detail: The first two attempts returned "Finalized chain state has not passed the unused authorization window" and held the reserve rather than concluding. Forno's finalized tag lagged the authorization's expiry by roughly 23 minutes; once finalized state passed it, the third attempt matched the AuthorizationUsed log and settled. The recorded transaction hash equals the one verified independently before reconciliation ran.

limitations: One call from the project's own sponsor wallet; this is not independent-user demand
No claim is made about bounty eligibility or scoring
